name: Creamy Cheddar-Tuna Pasta with Sautéed Broccoli & Zucchini

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and transfer to a medium bowl, reserving pot for later use.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and separate broccoli into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ¼-inch thick half-moons. Add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add broccoli, zucchini, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until veggies are tender-crisp, 7-8 minutes. Cover, remove from heat, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, cut cream cheese into small pieces; coarsely grate cheddar.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (227 g) block cream cheese
¾ (227 g) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Once the pasta has been drained, place both cheeses, milk, salt, and paprika in the reserved pot. Set over medium heat and bring the mixture to a simmer, whisking frequently, until cheeses melt and combine, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml whole milk
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: Drain tuna and flake with a fork; add to the cheese sauce along with the cooked pasta. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, 3-4 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (170 g) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pasta and veggies between plates or bowls. Top pasta with crushed red pepper and enjoy!
